title: Script Statements v3.4

statements.name: if
statements.description: IF-ELSE statement. The 'expr' should be a valid logical expression. The logical operators that can be used in the logical expressions: ==, !=, =~, !~, >, >=, <, <=, &&, ||, !, [ ... ].

statements.name: switch
statements.description: SWITCH statement - it can be used to test the value of a pseudo-variable. IMPORTANT NOTE: 'break' can be used only to mark the end of a 'case' branch (as it is in shell scripts). If you are trying to use 'break' outside a 'case' block the script will return error -- you must use 'return' there.

statements.name: for each
statements.description: for each statement - easy iteration over indexed variables or pseudo-variables

parameters.name: $(var[*])
parameters.description: Indexed variable or pseudo-variable to iterate over.
